race.comment: BEAUTY BEAST (2) has been a little hard to follow, missing the frame last time but was a Grade 5 winner three starts ago and has drawn 2 where she has two wins. Has the ability and expected to go close. MINTER DELICIOUS (8) was sent out at big odds from this same box last time but ran above herself when a 1.3 lengths third (19.50) at this track in Grade 5. Must include in calculations. FLYING NARDO (5) was out of placings last time (19.83) at this track in a Grade 5, finishing fifth and beaten 2.75 lengths. Already a winner from this draw. Can feature with the right run. DARNUM BEAR (4) generally performs well here at this distance.
